title: FastHydroMap
description: FastHydroMap predicts residue-level dewetting free energy (Fdewet) and water-structure components PC1, PC2 and PC3 from protein structures and trajectories. The software includes a shared four-target model, a command-line interface and a Python API. The MIT license applies to the software; bundled third-party parameter data retain the terms in licenses/VIPARR-FF-LICENSE.txt. HydroMap simulation-derived labels, protein structures and precomputed refitting inputs are deposited separately in the linked dataset.
